newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei to drift near 18,000, direction vague.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei to drift near 18,000, direction vague.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's barometer Nikkei average was expected to drift near the 18,000 mark in the Friday session, lacking firm cues to push it in any particular direction, brokers said. They added that the recent rebound in financial stocks was likely to continue.
The 225-share Nikkei average on Thursday rose 62.21 points or 0.35 percent to end at 18,093.41, ranging from 17,970.10 to 18,100.31. June Nikkei futures gained 40 points to 18,080.
"In the past few sessions, gains above 18,000 have been very hard to sustain and today should be no different," said Kunihiro Hatae, Tokyo Securities general manager.
